items.title: Nvidia raises fiscal 2028 sales-growth outlook as AI demand persists
items.summary: During its November 17 earnings call, Nvidia raised its fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook to about 75% from 70%, citing demand and greater supply support. The stock gained approximately 2% after hours around 5:10 PM ET, an unconfirmed extended-session move. Continued customer spending and margin delivery remain the tests.

observations.label: Growth outlook change (management call)
observations.value: Fiscal 2028 revenue growth approximately 75%, up from 70% previously

observations.label: After-hours market reaction
observations.value: Approximately +2% around 5:10 PM EST November 17; preliminary, not an official close

observations.label: Next checks
observations.value: Hyperscaler capital spending, AI deployment and GPU utilization, gross margins, customer credit exposure, China/export controls

items.key_finding: Nvidia raised its longer-horizon growth expectations even as market scrutiny of AI financing intensified.

items.title: Nvidia discloses $518 billion future commitments and $118 billion maximum guarantees
items.summary: Nvidia's SEC-filed quarterly CFO commentary shows $518 billion of scheduled multiyear commitments, including $390 billion in supply commitments, plus separately disclosed $32 billion conditional neocloud arrangements. Maximum gross guarantees total $118 billion, much of it tied to an Ohio campus for OpenAI. These are not immediate cash losses, but they expose interdependent AI infrastructure financing risks.

observations.label: Future commitments at October 25, 2026
observations.value: $518B total scheduled; includes $390B supply/capacity, $28B cloud agreements, $74B uncommenced data-center leases, $20B equity investments and $6B capex

observations.label: Additional neocloud agreements
observations.value: $32B maximum, conditional on customer financing and deployment and acceptance of infrastructure

observations.label: Maximum gross guarantees
observations.value: $118B total; $105B conditional SB Energy/Ohio OpenAI campus, $3.5B neocloud leases, $9.5B power and systems; no guarantee payments reported

observations.label: Liquidity and execution watch
observations.value: $53.5B cash/marketable debt, receivables $81B; DSO 64 vs 60 days; follow lease commencements, customer financing and defaults

observations.label: Next checks
observations.value: SEC 10-Q when filed, financed customer deployments, AI capacity utilization, terms of guarantees, cash conversion, receivables and inventory

items.key_finding: AI hardware demand is strong, but Nvidia is assuming substantial multiyear and conditional financing exposure to sustain the infrastructure buildout.

items.title: US equity indexes end broadly lower ahead of Nvidia report, extending technology-led decline
items.summary: US stocks closed lower for another session with broad selling despite a recovery from the day's steepest losses. Technology leadership, elevated financing costs and export controls remained important risk factors. These closing figures predate Nvidia's newly released earnings and do not establish a specific deterioration in chip demand.

observations.label: November 17 4:00 PM EST regular-session close, WSJ and AP
Earlier intraday conditions
observations.value: S&P 500 had declined as much as about 1.7%; late recovery reduced index losses, not breadth weakness

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: Wednesday breadth, credit spreads, rates, software relative strength and market reaction to Nvidia guidance; broad participation and stabilization would weaken deterioration signal

items.key_finding: The session ended with corroborated broad declines, but fundamental AI demand must be judged against earnings rather than price action alone.

items.title: Houthi pipeline claim and U.S. Qeshm retaliation deepen Gulf export risk
items.summary: Houthis claim they launched five drones at two Saudi East-West pipeline pumping stations, but Saudi authorities have not confirmed damage or interrupted flows. Separately, AP reports a U.S. official acknowledged a strike on an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island after Iranian drones targeted Bahrain. Crude prices rose intraday, while verified new export losses remain absent.

observations.label: Reported November 17 pipeline threat
observations.value: Houthis claim five drones toward two Saudi East-West pipeline pumping stations; no Saudi damage or flow confirmation (Reuters)

observations.label: Pipeline exposure
observations.value: Approximately 4 million barrels/day rerouted to Yanbu via East-West pipeline, around 4% of global supply (Reuters)

observations.label: U.S. retaliation verification
observations.value: AP cites U.S. official confirming strike on IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm Island; local official reported no civilian or infrastructure damage

observations.label: November 17 1:48 PM EST intraday
observations.value: Brent $93.50/barrel (+1.15%); WTI $86.56/barrel (+0.98%) (Reuters); not settlement

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: Saudi ministry, operator and pipeline throughput confirmation, Yanbu loadings, tanker insurance, UKMTO/MARAD and Brent/WTI/XLE/XOP; uninterrupted flow weakens disruption thesis

items.key_finding: Gulf escalation now reaches a critical Saudi oil bypass route, but new physical supply loss is unverified.

items.title: NSA attributes classified-network disruption to maintenance as US equities tumble
items.summary: NSA acknowledged temporary internal-system degradation during routine maintenance and said mission-critical operations remained functional. CBS verified a classified network outage and reported no evidence of cyberattack. U.S. equities were sharply lower around 3:02 PM ET, but the outage has not been shown to cause the broader selloff.

observations.label: Official agency status November 17
observations.value: Temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance; mission-critical capabilities operational (NSA)

observations.label: Independent reporting November 17
observations.value: Classified NSA Net interruption, staggered employee arrivals, no evidence of malicious attack (CBS, updated 2:40 PM EST)

observations.label: 3:02 PM EST intraday market snapshot
observations.value: Dow down more than 1,000 points (~2%); S&P 500 -1.6%; Nasdaq -1.5% (MarketWatch); not settlement

observations.label: Next checks and invalidation
observations.value: NSA restoration notice, root-cause and patching details, correlation to other systems, QQQ/IGV breadth and Nvidia guidance; routine recovery limits systemic risk interpretation

items.key_finding: An officially acknowledged NSA maintenance incident coincided with broad selling; no cyberattack or market causality established.
